scope: Ten-case native screen only. Each target compares candidate and retained Phase185 final N2 against the same-campaign C. Three serial rotated rounds; exact output and count oracle; ratios are medians per role, not a paired significance claim. No targets executed by this analysis.

emissionDiagnostics.scope: Single observations, same selected ten sources, different API/compiler sources, campaign sizes and order. Historical QBE is the authenticated 44+1 recovered merge after a 180s partial deadline. These are diagnostic absolute totals, not balanced compiler-performance ratios. Preparation excludes the separately reported base stage. Product bytes are text, not native code size.

localFoldX86Static.scope: Positive iteration only: eight loop-entry instructions through jz __b2 plus __b2 to __b4; no prologue, zero-return epilogue, or error block. Source-assembly instruction counts, not dynamic retirement counters.
localFoldX86Static.interpretation: Tuple and array-snapshot scratch address constructions and indirect 64-bit loads/stores vanish. One native 32-bit array load and store remain. Two Boolean materializations/checks, scalar copies, and 12 explicit frame references remain. This is consistent with the measured local-fold screen improvement, not an isolated causal attribution.
